Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Step-DPO: Step-wise Preference Optimization for Long-chain Reasoning of LLMs (2406.18629v1) · paper method: On MATH, the Qwen2-7B-SFT ablation reports 54.8% baseline,55.0% with DPO and 55.8% with Step-DPO.

cohort5.claim.stepdpo.ablation-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • Both preference methods use 5,000 training records in this ablation; MATH evaluation has 5,000 problems. These values do not describe the full 10,000-record main run.
